text:
Maya Patel: FYI PRs merged but docs examples failing in a couple places. Key items: Go SDK constructor changed, TTL formatting inconsistent, and quant-profile link broken in one snippet.
Devon Liu: Noted. I'll update the Go snippets to use the v2 constructor and the WithAPIKey pattern. Will also add a tiny migration note in optimize/upgrade.md.
Sara Ortiz: Do we have an automated check for snippet compilation across languages? If not, can we at least run samplegen before merging?
Devon Liu: samplegen flagged the Go example earlier. I created branch fix/docs-go-snippets and pushed changes: replaced OldClient with newsdk.NewClient and fixed imports.
Tomás Rivera: I also caught the TTL mismatch in optimize/cache.md: someone used raw milliseconds instead of a duration literal. Opened PR to normalize to `30 * time.Second`.
doc-bot: [automated] samplegen run: branch fix/docs-go-snippets  failures: 2 files optimize/kv-prefetch.md (go snippet), optimize/cache.md (ttl format). Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/ci/7890/logs
Maya Patel: Devon, Tomas, please coordinate and make sure CI passes before merging. Sara will run a local samplegen and smoke test.
Devon Liu: Pushed updated snippet. Example now: ```go
client := newsdk.NewClient(ctx, newsdk.WithAPIKey(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")))
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, &newsdk.GenerateRequest{Model: "redwood/opt-1", Prompt: "Hello"})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```
Sara Ortiz: Running samplegen v0.4.1 locally against the branch now. Also added a tiny unit test to ensure the Go snippet compiles in examples/test_examples.go.
Tomás Rivera: PR for TTL change: `cache.WithTTL(30 * time.Second)` and updated explanation text to recommend using duration literals for clarity.
Devon Liu: Added crosslink fix: quant-profile table link was still pointing to the old slug. Updated to /optimize/quant-profiles and added anchor for 
```
